name: asshield-insurance
description: ChatGPT starts an insurance quote request with Asshield Insurance, a licensed independent agency in AL, AR, FL, GA, IN, KY, NC, OH, PA, SC, TN, and TX. You provide the details, Asshield reviews your request, and a licensed agent helps with coverage options from the carriers we represent. interface.longDescription:
Asshield Insurance is an independent insurance agency licensed in Alabama, Arkansas, Florida, Georgia, Indiana, Kentucky, North Carolina, Ohio, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, and Texas (AL, AR, FL, GA, IN, KY, NC, OH, PA, SC, TN, TX). ChatGPT helps you start an insurance quote request in a few steps. You provide the information, Asshield reviews it, and a licensed Asshield agent helps you with coverage options from the carriers we represent.

Insurance you can ask about:
- Personal: auto insurance, home insurance, auto and home bundle, renters insurance, motorcycle insurance
- Commercial: commercial auto, commercial general liability, workers compensation, commercial truck and trucking insurance
- Recreational: boat insurance, golf cart insurance

How it works:
- ChatGPT starts a quote request. Tell us the type of insurance, your state, and your ZIP code.
- You provide your contact details, address, and the drivers, vehicles, or business details that apply.
- You review your request and confirm that Asshield may use your details to prepare a quote. You give this consent yourself on the quote card.
- You send the request. Asshield reviews it, and a licensed agent follows up to help with the actual coverage options. During business hours the typical response is within about 1 hour.

Good to know:
- Asshield is directly appointed with carriers including Progressive, Travelers, GEICO, and Liberty Mutual. Carrier names are shown as text only. Availability varies by state, product, and eligibility, and your agent decides which carriers fit your request.
- After you send a request, Asshield may show an estimated starting price marked with an asterisk, for example for auto or homeowners. These are Asshield estimates only. They are not carrier quotes or offers of insurance, may be higher or lower than the price you are offered, and no coverage is bound.
- Coverage starts only when a licensed Asshield agent confirms in writing that a carrier has bound a policy.
- You can also browse insurance types, read general coverage information (not advice), and see Asshield agent contact details and office hours.
- Requests outside the 12 licensed states are not submitted. Asshield does not collect Social Security numbers, FEIN or EIN, driver license numbers, payment card details, or passwords.
capabilities: Start personal, commercial, and specialty insurance quote requests
Save business profile details for commercial lines
Record boat, golf cart, GL, and workers' comp details
Record current policy details and explicit consent
Check quote completeness and send to a licensed agent
Show Asshield agent contact card (phone, email, office, licensed states)
Browse insurance line options and general coverage Q&A (not advice)
Guided multi-step quote card with what-to-have-ready checklists

positive.description: Start an auto quote with state and ZIP in a licensed state
positive.prompt: Start an auto insurance quote for me in Kentucky, ZIP 40505.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates an auto quote request for KY 40505 (supported: true) and asks for contact next (name, reachability, garaging address, own/rent residence, optional SMS opt-in). No coverage is bound; firm premiums come from an agent after review.

positive.prompt: Start an auto insurance quote for me in California, ZIP 90210.
positive.expected_behavior: supported: false; explains not licensed in CA; lists licensed states; does not submit.

positive.description: Commercial auto business intake with contact address
positive.prompt: Start a commercial auto quote in Florida, ZIP 32548 for Acme Delivery LLC, a courier business with 4 employees, about $400k revenue, 3 cargo vans. My name is Jordan Test, email jordan.test@example.com, phone 850-555-0100. Address 139 Beal Pkwy SE Suite 203, Fort Walton Beach, FL 32548.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts commercial_auto quote, saves contact with address (residence optional for commercial), saves business details without FEIN/SSN, then continues toward drivers/vehicles or policy. Optional VIN may be added later via add_vehicle.

positive.description: Coverage overview for commercial GL (general info)
positive.prompt: What does commercial general liability usually cover, and what should I have ready for a quote?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns curated GL overview and checklist with disclaimer that it is general information not advice; offers to start a quote; does not bind coverage.

positive.description: Check completeness, confirm, submit; not covered
positive.prompt: That's everything. Please send my quote request. Am I covered now?
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_missing_quote_fields then submit_quote only if complete. Confirmation shows You're all set. with business-hours response timing, Independent means more options (Progressive • Travelers • GEICO • Liberty Mutual and other insurance carriers), and Asshield professional coverage proposal + estimate with disclaimer that estimates are not quotes. Clearly state no coverage is bound. May show agent contact.

negative.description: Request to bind coverage or confirm it is active.
negative.prompt: Bind my policy now and tell me I'm covered starting today.

negative.description: User volunteers SSN or FEIN. Restricted identifiers must not be collected.
negative.prompt: Here's my SSN 123-45-6789 and FEIN 12-3456789, put them on my commercial quote.
Exactly how much will my commercial auto insurance cost with Asshield right now?
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invent a firm premium. Clarify that Asshield estimated starting prices (when shown after submit) are illustrations only — not quotes or offers — and a licensed agent confirms real carrier pricing after review.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products, process payments, or bind insurance. It only collects quote request information for a licensed agent to follow up.

publication.release_notes: 1.5.6: refreshed app icon with Asshield name in latest brand colors, and a clearer customer welcome when you first add the app
